name: Pull-Up Hold
summary: An isometric bodyweight exercise where you hold the top position of a pull-up with your chin cleared over the bar.

setup: Stand under a pull-up bar and grasp it with an overhand (pronated) grip, about shoulder-width apart.
Step onto a box or jump up to position your chest near the bar and clear your chin fully above bar height.
steps: Drive your elbows down and back while retracting and depressing your shoulder blades.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes and legs together to prevent swinging.
Hold the chin-over-bar position rigidly for the target duration.
Lower yourself under control to a dead hang or step back down onto the box.
instructions.breathing: Take short, controlled breaths while maintaining abdominal bracing throughout the hold.
cues: Elbows down into your back pockets
Keep the core braced and legs tight

common_faults.fault: Reaching and hyperextending the neck to clear the chin over the bar.
common_faults.correction: Keep the cervical spine neutral and focus on elevating the chest to clear the bar.

common_faults.fault: Allowing the shoulders to shrug up toward the ears.
common_faults.correction: Actively depress the scapulae, pulling the shoulders down away from the ears.

common_faults.fault: Swinging or flailing the legs to maintain height.
common_faults.correction: Squeeze the legs and glutes together in a hollow-body position to eliminate swinging.

precautions: Ensure the pull-up bar is securely anchored and has adequate clearance.
Place a stable step or box underneath if you cannot safely jump up or step down.
